title: Xebia scores highest on technical affinity but is far too big for a first partner
content:
Xebia scores best in the workbook on technical affinity and has real community reach through Xebia Academy and its conference presence. On the axis most leads fail — whether the bench would recognise a modern stack as its own kind of work — it scores highest of the set.

Two things hold it back, and both are about shape rather than skill. Its Dutch headcount has still not been isolated from a 7,511-person global group that is roughly 61% India-based, so what would actually be engaged is unclear; and the group as a whole is far too big for a first design partner. Community reach cuts both ways as well: a firm with an academy and a conference programme is a strong amplifier once there is something to amplify, and a poor venue for shaping something that does not exist yet.

The sequencing conclusion matches the other large agnostic firms in the set: valuable later, wrong first. Priority 3.
